Streaming chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) yielding multiple SSE chunks

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["maxTokens" => 32, "messages" => [["content" => "Count to three, one word per response.", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022", "stream" => true]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$chunks = iterator_to_array($client->chatStream($req));
```
